note: Most reported cohorts lack overt primary cardiomyopathy, but recent reports describe myocardial injury at presentation and cardiac phenotypes in Drosophila models.

evidence.text: A pediatric case of LGMDR29 presented with isolated myocardial injury and markedly elevated CK/CK-MB following infection, although cardiac structure and function on echocardiography were normal.

source.title: A Case of Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Type R29 Presenting with Myocardial Damage as the Initial Manifestation: A case report
source.quote: Cardiac structure and function, as assessed by echocardiography, were found to be normal, and the patient did not exhibit any typical symptoms of muscle weakness.

evidence.text: Fly orthologue models of SNUPN have been linked to cardiac conduction defects and cardiomyopathy, suggesting cardiac tissue susceptibility cannot be completely excluded.

source.title: Drosophila melanogaster: A Model Organism in Muscular Dystrophy Studies
